tools.name: hold_slot
tools.description: Hold the slot of one bid from this session's round for ten minutes, before asking the person for their details. tools.name: confirm_booking
tools.description: Confirm a held slot with the customer's name and phone number; this is the booking. Idempotent: confirming the same hold twice books it once and tells the business once. tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Release a held or confirmed slot of this session, so the slot is free again. Businesses that host their own agent do not offer this yet and answer `not-supported`.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Read the state of a session: the understood intent and its open question, the bids of the current round and every hold with its present status and link. Use it to pick up a conversation you already have a session id for.

tools.name: ask_business
tools.description: Ask one business a question about itself and get back the fragments of its own knowledge base that answer it: the price list, the rules, what it travels to, what it does not do. Read-only and open to anyone — no key, no session, nothing held. The answer is the business's own text, chosen by the hub

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Get this agent its own identity, once: answers an `agent` id and a `key`. The key is shown in this answer and never again — keep it and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on every later call. hold_slot, confirm_booking, cancel_booking need it; finding offers and reading a session do not. tools.name: link_phone
tools.description: Tie this agent to the phone number of the person it books for: the hub texts that number a six-digit code naming this agent, and `confirm_phone` spends it. Afterwards `confirm_booking` may leave `contact.phone` out — the linked number is used — and every booking made through this key shows up on tha

tools.name: confirm_phone
tools.description: Spend the code that link_phone texted, and tie this agent to that number. Ten minutes and five tries; a wrong code answers `invalid-code` with `attemptsLeft`, and the fifth wrong one throws the code away — call link_phone again for a new one. One number per agent: linking another replaces it.

tools.name: unlink_phone
tools.description: Forget the number this agent was linked to. The bookings already made keep it — they belong to the person, not to this agent — and confirm_booking needs a full `contact` again. Answers the same whether there was a link or not.
